How close SpaceX lets you get to Starship before launch
caption:
Starship is the largest rocket ever built. Standing next to it 90 minutes before launch, the scale is unlike anything else.

SpaceX builds Starship to eventually carry people to the Moon and Mars. Every launch is another step closer. This was filmed around 90 minutes before liftoff today, September 28, for Flight 14.

Most people only ever see it from miles away or in photos. This is what it actually looks like from the ground.
